gaps: No official upstream Baxter–Sagart data row was directly inspected: the cited PDF returned 502. The supplied exact local Baxter–Sagart rows nevertheless provide same-system values for 現 ‘appear’ *N-[k]ˤen-s, 見 ‘appear’ *N-[k]ˤen-s, and 見 ‘see’ *[k]ˤen-s. Preserve the local file/row provenance and do not present the local table as an external source.

The matching local Baxter–Sagart readings for 現 and 見 in the ‘appear’ entries do not independently establish that the visible right-hand graphic element in 現 is 見 or that it functioned phonologically at the time of formation. A primary paleographic or philological argument for that graphic role was not inspected.

The external secondary Zhengzhang comparison gives 現 *ɡeːns and 見 *keːns/*ɡeːns; this is a different reconstruction system from Baxter–Sagart. The current Mandarin readings are 見 jiàn and 現 xiàn; these present-day values are not evidence of the earlier sound relation.

Official Unicode character-specific pages for 見 U+898B and 現 U+73FE could not be accessed through the web tool. The supplied local Unihan rows give 見 jiàn and 現 xiàn; only the 现 U+73B0 reading xiàn and traditional variant 現 were independently confirmed on an official Unicode page.

No component image verifies a historical form of 現 itself. The inspected candidate images depict 玉 or 見 independently. The visible search/source pages do not resolve the chronology of 現’s jade-related and ‘appear’ senses, nor establish a graph-borrowing versus nasal-prefix derivation.
